segments.text: Updates to the action bar in 2024 release wave one make it simpler to use and make you more productive. We've tidied up the workspace a bit.

First, there's a new icon for analysis mode. It's in the same place and still turns analysis mode on and off, but now takes up less space. We've also created space by removing the captions for search and analysis mode.
Copilot's now on the action bar, so it's easier to reach Copilot actions on any list page. Lastly, everyone can now enjoy the updates to the action bar.
It's now standard and the process tab is now called home. It's where the most popular actions are. There you'll find split buttons that group popular actions for fast access.
To learn more, go to aka.ms/bcactionbar.
